      --color-paper: #f5f5f5;

      --font-mono: ui-monospace,'SFMono-Regular',Menlo,Consolas,'Noto Sans TC',monospace;

      --motion-total: 3600ms;
      --motion-ease: cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);
    }
.dd-template-motion [data-motion-root], .dd-template-motion[data-motion-root]{ width: min(100%, 1000px); }

      opacity: .12;

      transform-origin: center;

                  transform var(--motion-step) var(--motion-ease);

    }

    }

    }

.dd-example-kanban-full .container, .dd-example-kanban-full.container{ max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; }
.dd-example-kanban-full .header, .dd-example-kanban-full.header{ margin-bottom: 2.5rem; }
.dd-example-kanban-full .header-eyebrow, .dd-example-kanban-full.header-eyebrow{ font-family: ui-monospace,'SFMono-Regular',Menlo,Consolas,'Noto Sans TC',monospace; font-size: 0.66rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-muted); margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }
.dd-example-kanban-full .subtitle, .dd-example-kanban-full.subtitle{ font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--color-muted); max-width: 58ch; }
